bio_en: Dr Artashes Babalian was born in Shushi on 17 November 1886 (Old Style) and joined the ARF as a youth. In 1915, a newly graduated doctor, he volunteered for the front, fighting in all his regiment's battles first as a soldier and then as a physician. In 1918 he worked in Armenia amid epidemics, and after Sovietisation he was arrested with other comrades and held for a long time before being released. He then lived in Tehran, where he chaired the ARF's community bodies, the church administration and the diocesan council, and was licensee of the daily Alik; he died on 1 August 1959.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
